description: One page of the published sample files, filtered by format, tag and size. Each comes with its URL and a description of what it is for. `total` counts every match and `next_offset` fetches the next page; it is null on the last.

format.description: Formats to include, any of, e.g. ["pdf", "png"].

limit.description: Fixtures per page, 50 unless set, at most 250.

max_bytes.description: Only files of at most this size.

tag.description: Tags to include, any of, e.g. ["encrypted"].

name: list_fixtures
title: List loremfile.dev fixtures
